nodes.title: Bot: Double-or-Nothing rematch flow
nodes.description:
After resolve, winner DM gets a 🎲 'Double or Nothing' button. Click → modal pre-filled prompting loser to type new criteria → bot doubles the original stake + forks a rematch bet stamped with parent_bet_id + chain_depth. 5-min TTL on rematch drafts (sweep stale offers via watchdog). Embeds on descendant bets show '🎲 Rematch: #N (parent: #shortcode)'.

DB: add bets.parent_bet_id, bets.chain_depth (int), bets.is_rematch_draft + draft expires_at fields. Migration.

Viral: every win surfaces a one-tap rematch CTA. Saybet shipped this as their Phase 1.10.

nodes.title: Bot: open bets — /saybet with no opponent
nodes.description:
/saybet amount:10 criteria:"..." with NO opponent option = open challenge, first user in the channel to tap Accept takes the other side.

Flow: bot posts public embed '⚔️ <@challenger> is throwing it out there — first to tap Accept takes the other side'. ATOMIC claim race: only one accept wins regardless of how fast people click. Self-claim blocked. Outstanding-bet gate applies to claimer too.

DB: bets.accepter_id becomes nullable. New column bets.is_open_bet. Migration.

Saybet shipped as Phase 1.10b. Plumb through their atomic claim test pattern.

nodes.title: Bot: 10-round negotiation back-and-forth
nodes.description:
Counter-offer flow before bet is locked in. Plays alongside our chat-disambig (s-disambig-chat): disambig nails down WHAT the bet is; negotiation lets either side adjust amount/deadline/terms before accepting.

Flow:
1. Challenge embed has [Accept] [Decline] AND [✏️ Propose Changes].
2. Propose → modal pre-filled with current criteria (or amount/deadline) → submit.
3. LLM re-normalises the counter-proposal canonical sentence.
4. Other party receives DM 'Counter from <@you> · Round 1 of 10' with [Accept | Counter Back | Walk Away].
5. Repeat up to 10 rounds. Round 10 → snark cancel: '🫠 Ten rounds and you mandem still can't agree. saybet don't move like that. Bet cancelled.' (post in channel + both DMs).
6. Walk Away during negotiation = unilateral cancel (bet wasn't mutually accepted yet).
7. Persist every round in bets_negotiation_history (bet_id, round, actor, proposed_terms_canonical, created_at).

Migration: bets.negotiation_round int default 0; new bet_negotiation_history table.

Major dispute-prevention play. Saybet shipped as Phase 1.11.

nodes.title: Bot: 24h timeout on pending cancel requests
nodes.description:
When a participant requests /cancel, the counterparty has 24h to Agree or Deny. After 24h with no response, request auto-reverts (no cancel happens, bet stays in its current state). Implement in apps/bot/src/watchdog.ts as a sibling to the deadline nudge cron.

DB: cancel_requested_at field on bets (nullable). Migration.

nodes.title: Contract+Bot: EIP-712 sigs for gasless resolve confirmation
nodes.description:
Extend our EIP-712 outcome-contract pattern (s-eip712-sig is for INITIAL terms): also use EIP-712 typed-data sigs for the resolve confirmation step. Either participant signs 'I confirm <winner> won bet <id>' off-chain; bot collects both sigs; if they match (same winner), bot calls resolve() on-chain itself. Users never pay gas on the confirm step.

If sigs disagree → arbiter path triggers (existing s-disambig-chat / arbiterResolve flow).

Saved gas: ~$0.002 per resolve on Solana, but more importantly removes the 'wallet popup confirm' friction at resolution time. Users just tap a Discord button.

Low priority — only worth doing once we have volume. Saybet's Phase 3+ design called for this.

nodes.title: Ops: Squads multisig for Solana treasury (replaces Safe-on-Base plan)
nodes.description:
After the Solana pivot, treasury multisig is Squads (https://squads.so) — Solana-native, same idea as Safe on EVM. Ops plan:

1. Now → first real money: 2-of-3 Squads on Solana mainnet. Three hardware wallets (Ledger Nano X with Solana app) physically distributed across team.
2. Real treasury: separate hot operational Squads (2-of-3, lower amounts) from cold treasury Squads (3-of-5, larger amounts). Auto-sweep operational → cold above threshold.
3. Volume: look at programmatic signers (e.g., Turnkey Solana support) for per-tx automation.

For MVP testnet (current): a single resolver hot wallet has DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Migrate to Squads pre-mainnet.

Supersedes the earlier Safe-multisig plan since we pivoted off Base.

nodes.title: Docs: cozy-bet positioning (the saybet supersession story)
nodes.description:
Capture the strategic positioning: cozy-bet is the version saybet wanted to be, more professionally built. Specifically the architectural divergence:

- Saybet: custodial buckets per chain; operator is market-maker; rebalance manually + via CCTP; users trust saybet not to rug.
- Cozy-bet: non-custodial smart-contract escrow on Solana; multi-chain ingest via Mayan/Squid aggregator (CCTP burn-and-mint); funds never sit with operator.

Write docs/positioning.md or extend README. Frame:
- What we are: 'bridging online larps with real stakes' (saybet's framing — credit it).
- What's different vs saybet: non-custodial, smart-contract-enforced, EIP-712 signed terms.
- Why this matters: lower regulatory exposure (no money-transmitter posture), no rug-pull trust, real arbiter path with on-chain accountability.
